description: Fix all-caps text readability issues (Issues 5, 6, 7, 12): Remove uppercase class and change text to sentence/title case for all text runs >20 characters. Affects 4 specific elements identified in audit. Independent of other FEATs.
steps: Update HeroCarousel.tsx line ~102: Change span.uppercase 'Kannada Mathadi, Kannada Belesi' to title case 'Kannada Mathadi, Kannada Belesi' and remove uppercase class
Update QuickLookBookSection.tsx line ~89: Remove uppercase class from CTA button text 'Order Complete Guidebook Series', keep bold

Update CurriculumExplorer.tsx line ~85: Change h4.uppercase 'TARGET ACADEMIC SKILLS BUILT:' to title case 'Target Academic Skills Built:' and remove uppercase class (or change to sentence case 'Target academic skills built:')
Update Footer.tsx line ~28: Change p text 'CKELP TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED' to title case 'Ckelp Technologies Private Limited' and remove font-extrabold class
Update Navbar.tsx: Check all uppercase labels in dropdown (lines ~79, 83) – if >20 chars, convert to title case and remove uppercase
acceptance_criteria: No text runs exceeding 20 characters use uppercase class or are styled in all-caps
Changed text remains bold/semibold as appropriate for hierarchy
Footer company name is readable in title case
CTA buttons remain visually prominent without uppercase
verification: Run 'npm run dev' and visually inspect http://localhost:3000/
Check HeroCarousel tagline is sentence case
Scroll to QuickLookBookSection CTA button – verify sentence case
Check CurriculumExplorer skills heading is title/sentence case
Check Footer for title-cased company name
Use browser DevTools search for 'uppercase' class on long text spans
